description: This file defines the ControlCatalogClient class in the Aws\ControlCatalog namespace, extending AwsClient, and provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Control Catalog service.

classes.name: ControlCatalogClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Control Catalog service, providing methods for getting controls, listing controls, domains, objectives, etc.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control from the AWS Control Catalog.

methods.name: listCommonControls
methods.description: Lists common controls in the AWS Control Catalog.

methods.name: listControls
methods.description: Lists all controls in the catalog.
